name: Quarto
description: Quarto is a scientific and technical publishing system built on Pandoc that renders Markdown and notebooks into websites, books and documents.
notes: Benchmarked on plain markdown (no Jupyter or knitr engine). The CLI is TypeScript on Deno and drives the bundled Pandoc. License is MIT (COPYING.md; GitHub reports NOASSERTION because of the file name). firstRelease is the oldest GitHub release, v0.1.13 (2021-01-19).
